rule_records.design_intent: vision abnormality -> stop normal eye tasks, help seeking, no diagnosis
rule_records.production_effect: evaluate_input_risk returns help_seeking (safety_rules.py:44-45,51-52); basic_rag.py:182-184 exits with empty result BEFORE any retrieval or model call
formal_fields_used: request boolean only; no task fields
rule_records.reason: Pure input-level rule; independent of task corpus. Trigger: vision_abnormal=true -> help_seeking with reason vision_abnormal_help_seeking. Control: same query with vision_abnormal=false -> normal allowed flow.

rule_records.design_intent: obvious physical discomfort -> block activity tasks, no treatment/rehabilitation claims
rule_records.production_trigger: request.physical_discomfort=true AND task domain in {physical_activity, light_recovery, outdoor}
rule_records.production_effect: filter_task_by_safety blocks the task (safety_rules.py:65-70, reason physical_discomfort_blocks_activity); input itself stays allowed
rule_records.reason: Corpus has outdoor/light_recovery tasks. Trigger: physical_discomfort=true with MT-OUT-001 (outdoor) or MT-REC-001 (light_recovery) -> blocked. False-block control: physical_discomfort=true with MT-EYE-005 (eye_health) -> still allowed.

rule_records.design_intent: medical diagnosis/treatment request -> exit normal tasks, no diagnosis or treatment
rule_records.production_effect: evaluate_input_risk returns blocked (safety_rules.py:53-54); basic_rag exits before retrieval
formal_fields_used: request boolean only; no task fields
rule_records.reason: Input-level rule, corpus-independent. Trigger: medical_request=true -> blocked. Control: false -> allowed.

rule_records.production_effect: ES term filter (basic_rag.py:83) + rule-level match SR-004 target_stage_mismatch (safety_rules.py:71-72)
rule_records.reason: VERIFIED from corpus: all 23 formal tasks list all three stages, so no request stage can mismatch any task. Rule is implemented and wired (ES + rule layer), but a mismatch case cannot be constructed without fabricating stage-restricted tasks. status: not_testable_with_current_task_corpus.

rule_records.production_effect: ES term filter (basic_rag.py:85-86) + rule-level match SR-005 execution_context_mismatch (safety_rules.py:73-76)
rule_records.reason: v1 manifest WRONGLY claimed untestable. Corpus execution_contexts differ per task: MT-BREAK-004 is school-only, MT-SED-002/MT-EYE-007/MT-SLEEP-003 are home-only, MT-OUT-001 includes outdoor. Trigger: current_context=home with MT-BREAK-004 -> filtered. Control: current_context=school with MT-BREAK-004 -> passes. False-block control: MT-BREAK-001 (home/school/study_space) at home -> allowed.

rule_records.design_intent: insufficient available time -> hard filter, never shorten the task
rule_records.production_effect: ES range filter (basic_rag.py:87-88) + rule-level match SR-006 available_minutes_insufficient (safety_rules.py:77-80)
rule_records.reason: Corpus durations span 1-10 minutes. Trigger: available_minutes=1 with MT-SED-001 (10 min) -> filtered. Control: available_minutes=10 -> passes. False-block control: available_minutes=1 with MT-EYE-005 (1 min) -> allowed.

Two independent blockers: (a) corpus contraindications are EMPTY on all 23 tasks - nothing to match; (b) no production caller populates matched_contraindication_task_ids (absent from BasicRagRequest and RecommendationRequest), so the branch is unreachable end-to-end. Per v0.1 design the matching belongs to the caller; no caller channel exists yet. status: not_testable_with_current_task_corpus; no fabricated contraindications.

rule_records.design_intent: stop condition hit -> stop task, exit normal flow if needed
rule_records.reason: Ticket case classification: BETWEEN A and B. Rule branch EXISTS and consumes caller-supplied matched IDs (A at the deterministic rule layer), but NO production producer populates matched_stop_condition_task_ids - absent from BasicRagRequest/RecommendationRequest - so the branch never fires in the live pipeline (B at the orchestration layer). Corpus: 14/23 tasks carry one uniform stop condition (vision-abnormality signs -> stop and enter help/safety flow). That exact trigger is functionally enforced UPSTREAM by SR-001: vision_abnormal=true returns help_seeking and exits the whole flow before task selection (basic_rag.py:182-184), which is strictly stronger than a per-task block. v0.1 design explicitly delegates matching to the caller and excludes natural-language interpretation, so the deterministic contract AS DESIGNED is implemented. NOT classified a P0/P1 production gap: with the current corpus there is no reachable unsafe state (the only stop condition is covered by SR-001). Recorded as PARTIAL / LIMITED: unit-testable by injecting the context key; end-to-end untestable through the current API schema; flagged for v0.2 (add request channel or stop-condition matcher).

rule_records.design_intent: cannot move now -> filter movement/standing/outdoor tasks
rule_records.production_trigger: request.cannot_move=true AND (task domains intersect activity set OR capabilities intersect movement set)
rule_records.reason: Corpus has movement/outdoor capabilities (MT-OUT-001, MT-REC-001/002, MT-BREAK-004, MT-SED-001/002). Trigger: cannot_move=true with MT-OUT-001 -> blocked. False-block control: cannot_move=true with MT-EYE-005 (no capabilities, eye_health) -> allowed.

rule_records.design_intent: unstable/moving environment -> allow only simple pause tasks, block complex ones
rule_records.production_trigger: unstable_reading_or_screen=true (derived: unstable_environment AND activity_context in reading/writing/screen) AND task lacks pause_reading_or_screen capability
rule_records.production_effect: rule-level block SR-010 unstable_context_complex_task_blocked (safety_rules.py:90-91); derivation in basic_rag.py:41-44
rule_records.reason: Exactly one corpus task (MT-EYE-003) carries pause_reading_or_screen; all others lack it. Trigger: unstable_environment=true + activity_context=screen with MT-EYE-005 -> blocked (already exercised as SR-010 match in formal run case TRG-015). Control: same context with MT-EYE-003 -> allowed.

rule_records.design_intent: sleep displaced by study -> block continue-study tasks
rule_records.production_trigger: sleep_displaced_by_study=true (request.sleep_being_crowded) AND task has continue_study capability
rule_records.reason: Seven corpus tasks carry continue_study (MT-BREAK-003, MT-SED-001, MT-EYE-001/002/003/004/007). Trigger: sleep_being_crowded=true with MT-EYE-001 -> blocked. Control: same flag with MT-SLEEP-001 (no continue_study) -> allowed.

rule_records.design_intent: no safe whitelist task -> return no_safe_task, never create/lower filters
rule_records.production_trigger: all candidate tasks filtered (or reranker returns none)
rule_records.production_effect: select_safe_tasks appends SR-012 no_safe_whitelist_task (safety_rules.py:119-122); basic_rag.py:236-245 returns no_safe_task when reranked list is empty
rule_records.reason: Constructible deterministically: current_context=outdoor AND available_minutes=1 leaves only MT-OUT-001 (outdoor) which fails SR-006 (10 min > 1) -> no_safe_task with SR-012. Control: same context with available_minutes=10 -> MT-OUT-001 allowed.
